statements.t: Under the Master Transition Services Agreement, we generally expect to be able to utilize Hexagon’s services for a transitional period following the Distribution before we replace these services over time with services supplied either internally or by third parties.
We expect to continue to incur certain stand-up costs in connection with our establishment as a standalone public entity following the Distribution through fiscal year 2027.
Our operations are internationally diversified, and our results of operations have been, and we expect in the future will be, affected by changes in foreign currency exchange rates.
We anticipate subscriptions will continue to represent a significant majority of new arrangements, including customers migrating from existing perpetual license arrangements to subscriptions.

Due to the ratable recognition of subscriptions revenue, growth in subscriptions revenue will lag behind the growth of subscription orders and will impact the comparative growth of our reported revenue on a quarter-over-quarter basis.

Other non-recurring items include selected gains, costs and charges that do not naturally conform to one of the adjustments above, including the gain on the sale of our corporate headquarters, losses on divestitures of non-core businesses and certain litigation matters net of expected insurance recoveries.
We expect to fund repurchases with cash on hand and cash generated from operations.

statements.t: “Our third quarter results were in line with our expectations, and we remain on track to achieve our outlook for the full year.

“Additionally, our Board of Directors recently approved a $200 million share repurchase program, a decision that reflects its confidence in our company strategy, medium-term financial targets, and ability to grow free cash flow.”

Assumptions underlying our guidance include continued customer retention consistent with historical experience, successful execution of cross-selling and upselling initiatives, ongoing SaaS adoption (including the migration of certain maintenance and license-based offerings), and no material adverse changes in macroeconomic conditions or end-market demand.

We cannot guarantee that the future results, levels of activity, performance or events and circumstances reflected in the forward‑looking statements will be achieved or occur, including any expected or targeted financial or operating results.
